guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_mem rose +36.9% (z=+7.38) and its latency-50 fell sharply (z=-13.94), while checkoutservice logs 135 'failed to send order confirmation ... Unimplemented: Method not found' errors, pointing at emailservice as the failing callee. The Unimplemented error is an API/method mismatch rather than a resource fault, so mem is only the best-fitting category from the metric shift and the fault type is uncertain.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice's deployed version and gRPC SendOrderConfirmation method registration, then restart or roll back emailservice to a known-good build and check its memory growth. This is non-destructive.
